verdict.rationale: Homebrew documents per-project Brewfiles for declaring dependencies. However, nothing in the evidence shows a Brewfile, `brew bundle dump`, or any other command recording or enforcing exact package versions. Listing which packages a project needs is an adjacent feature, not version pinning. Community reports of upgrades users 'couldn't pin' and of the lack of a standard multi-version install point the same way.

support.subject: As a developer, I can pin exact versions of packages and tools per project and have the manager respect those pins
